name: Run assigned tasks
description: Runs an agent on its task the moment the task is assigned, and reports the outcome back to the board.

de.name: Zugewiesene Aufgaben ausführen
de.description: Startet den Agenten auf seiner Aufgabe, sobald sie ihm zugewiesen wird, und meldet das Ergebnis zurück ans Board.

fr.name: Exécuter les tâches assignées
fr.description: Lance l'agent sur sa tâche dès qu'elle lui est assignée et rapporte le résultat sur le tableau.

config.description: Assignment events on closed/archived tasks (e.g. bulk edits) must not start agent work.

parameters.instructions: You have been assigned this task on the project board. Do the work it describes to the best of your ability with the tools available, then post your final result as a task comment. Keep the result concise and reviewable — a human will review it next.

config.description: Internal runs park at In review now; external dispatches return immediately and the daemon's completion does it later. The In progress ack happens inside run admission (run_on_task), never before it — a refused run must not flash the status.
External work is asynchronous — leave the task In progress; the daemon completes it to In review (or the dispatch watchdog rolls it back).
An admitted run (a run row exists) was acked In progress before it failed — explain and roll back. A refused run never touched the status, so there is nothing to roll back.

parameters.body: [automated] ⚠️ {{input.assigneeId}} could not complete this task: {{steps.run.output.data.error || 'unknown error'}} — returned to To do.

steps.name: Did the refusal already explain itself?

config.description: Guardrail refusals post their own notices (queued / budget / breaker) and a deleted task has no timeline left — end quietly. Other refusals (agent disabled or not installed) get an explanatory comment; the status stays untouched either way.

steps.name: Explain why the run never started

parameters.body: [automated] ⚠️ {{input.assigneeId}} could not start this task: {{steps.run.output.data.error || 'unknown error'}} The task status was left unchanged. If the agent is not installed or enabled, enable it on the Agents page — connecting an integration alone does not enable its bundled agents.
